items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I used to know the owner of Old Man's Stapopola was a Greek, he made the upper phone guitar epic.

ctx.x: Yeah, it would be an afterbeat level. Yeah. Well that's giving you a nice little swing then. I'm sure there wasn't...

There was a lot of, not a lot of band here, but there were some band of players around New York, so you could come up to a place and they'd dance all the players sometimes. I can't believe, some fellow was a teacher. I can't believe, some fellow was a teacher. I can't believe, some of the same. But the banjo era, that didn't last too long in New York. I got there in 26 and I worked in a dance hall in 27 and 28 and then in 29 I had to swing the guitar. And the banjo just went out completely and I forgot about it.…
